The Foreign Scholarship Scheme by the Minority Development Department of the Government of Maharashtra aims to provide educational opportunities to minority students to pursue higher studies abroad. This initiative reflects the government's commitment to empower minority communities through quality education and exposure to global academic standards.

Under this scheme, eligible tribal students are granted scholarships to pursue various levels of education such as postgraduate and doctoral studies in reputed foreign universities and institutions. The scholarships cover tuition fees, accommodation, travel expenses, and other related costs, ensuring that financial constraints do not hinder the educational aspirations of deserving minority students
